name: Lindsey Wilson College
tuition_note: Private single-rate school. 2026-27 tuition & fees from lindsey.edu/admissions/cost-and-financial-aid/index.cfm: per-semester tuition $14,328 + activity fee $94 + technology fee $66 = $14,488/semester x 2 = $28,976 annual tuition & fees. Housing (room only) $1,924/semester x 2 = $3,848 annual; food/board excluded (food was $3,371/semester).
